evidence.observation: O2 at 4.6 ppm, in line with the ramp baseline of about 3-6 ppm
O2 has risen every reading during growth: 8.9, 12.7, 18.7, 24.3, 26.0 ppm, about 5x the baseline
Ar holding at 100 sccm per setpoint, so the rise is not from reduced purge flow
T steady at 750 C and heater power steady at about 45%, so the thermal side looks normal
Not installed, so the tube atmosphere can't be fully verified and I can't tell a seal leak from an exhaust blockage

args.missing_evidence: A tube pressure reading or a leak check (for example, pressure decay or a helium leak test, or checking the exhaust line for a restriction) would show whether this is a seal leak or an exhaust blockage/back-diffusion. Reference ranges for O2 during growth would also help.
